stem: A 6-week-old infant has forceful non-bilious vomiting after feeds and remains eager to feed. Which diagnosis best matches this vomiting pattern?
explanation: Pyloric stenosis typically presents at 2 to 6 weeks with progressive projectile non-bilious vomiting, hunger after feeds and hypochloraemic metabolic alkalosis.
